judge.voice: I got to the end without help, and nobody made me feel stupid. When I said sorry, Linga said ten years with guests is great practice. That helped. The dirty room and bank questions were my work, and I could answer them. But the film subtitles question was too hard and had nothing to do with a hotel. I felt tested. B1 feels too high for me, and the screen itself says it may be a little off, so I trust it only half. The summary could have been written for anyone. It never said angry guests or directions, which I told it I want. The tip about 'a restaurant' and 'five minutes' walk' I can use tomorrow. Nothing worried me as a mother. I would try again, but I want more desk situations and a level that feels honest. A language school would take me a whole evening, so this is quicker.
